notes.note: The quote changes every hour instead of once a day. All 31 lines take turns in a shuffled order, never the same one twice in a row, and an open dashboard shows the new line on the hour without a reload.

First release: a dashboard widget that shows one line from WALL·E, the same for everyone and new each day at midnight UTC. Thirty-one lines from WALL·E, EVE, AUTO, Captain McCrea and more, with nothing to set up.
